spool_directory.description: Directory used for storing pending, queued, and archived MMS messages.

database.description: Path to the SQLite database used for storing message metadata and user information.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to stderr and logs.

max_outgoing_transfers.description: Maximum number of simultaneous outgoing MMS transfers (e.g., to other MMSCs or SMSCs).

max_incoming_transfers.description: Maximum number of simultaneous incoming MMS transfers (e.g., from mobile subscribers).

max_message_size.description: Maximum allowed size (in bytes) for an MMS message. Set to 0 to disable size limits.

bind_address.description: Network interface IP address to bind the HTTP proxy port to (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

port.description: TCP port on which the MMSC HTTP proxy listens for incoming MMS submissions and retrieval.

upstream_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for outgoing connections to upstream MMSCs or SMSCs.

enable_wap_push.description: Enable WAP Push (SI/SL) delivery reports for MMS notifications.

mms_hostname.description: Hostname used in MMS headers (e.g., X-Mms-Message-ID) and MMSC identification.

default_sender.description: Default sender address used when the original sender cannot be determined (e.g., for MO relay).

allowed_subnets.description: List of IPv4 CIDR subnets allowed to send MMS via this MMSC (e.g., for relay or internal use).

smscs.description: List of SMSC gateway definitions for routing messages to/from external SMSCs.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the SMSC (e.g., 'smsc.vodafone.net').

port.description: TCP port for SMSC interface (typically 5000 for SMPP).

system_id.description: Optional SMSC system ID (used in some SMPP configurations).

mo_allowed_prefixes.description: List of allowed caller ID prefixes for Mobile-Originated (MO) messages in relay mode (e.g., '+1' or '+44').

items.description: E.164-style phone number prefix (e.g., '+1' for US/CA, '+44' for UK).
